sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def pp(frame):
    pts=[]
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','Y'): pts+=n['boundary']
    return (min(p[0] for p in pts),max(p[0] for p in pts),min(p[1] for p in pts),max(p[1] for p in pts)) if pts else None
def ncells(b,a):
    return sum(1 for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if b[r][c]!=a[r][c])
gb=grid(current_frame) if False else [list(r) for r in current_frame.ascii.split('\n')]
print("before:", pp(current_frame))
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':57,'col':45}])
ga=[list(r) for r in current_frame.ascii.split('\n')]
print("after MOUSE(57,45):", pp(current_frame), "cells changed:", ncells(gb,ga), "res:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
